en: Real photo postcard showing a black‑and‑white portrait of two men in suits. A handwritten message in Serbian runs across the top and left margin of the photo. The reverse has the standard 'CARTE POSTALE' layout with a red Swiss 10 rappen Helvetia stamp, machine cancel and circular postmark from Bern dated 23.VIII.1917. There is a pink censor/transfer handstamp reading FELDKIRCH and the address is written to Serbia.
